name: save-boot-16-mds7-talk-up-left
description: #168 fresh budget, attempt 2 (search and acceptance in one run). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mds7.json (field 151) and load. Phase 1: hold up+left with Circle held 7 of every 8 frames (a Circle edge every 8 frames while walking and facing the way the player goes) until window 0 leaves state 0 (win_wait: a talk opened a message or a choice; timeout 600). Phase 2: Circle (hold 2) every 8 frames until window 0's pointerEnabled reads 1 (ptr_wait: a choice shows its pointer; the wait ends on that frame, before the next edge could pick; timeout 900). Then the #168 acceptance: mark, Down (4 frames: one line) and 12 frames, mark, Up (4) and 12; window 0 still in state 6 (still6); Circle (4) picks and closes window 0 (close_wait: back to 0, timeout 300). pointerY ends lower than after Down (up_dir -1) and where the pointer appeared (back_dir 0). A rerun matches (match). The first zero says how far it got. Only frame counts and signs leave.
